facts.value: Applicants with a Department of Education and Skills (DES) Language Exemption from primary or post-primary school; Applicants without a DES Language Exemption but are exempt from taking a language due to findings of a psychological report; Applicants educated/part-educated outside of the Republic of Ireland (ROI).
Applications are only accepted online. Closing date for applications is 01 July 2026.
Complete the UL Language Exemption online application. Categories 2 and 3: Download and complete the UL Language Declaration Form and submit it with your application.

To complete your online application, you will require CAO Application Number, PPS Number/National Insurance Number, contact details including email address and phone number, and a legible scanned copy/digital photograph of your relevant supporting documentation ready to attach.
Applications must be made through the Central Applications Office (CAO) in accordance with rules and guidelines contained in the CAO handbook.
Normal Closing Date: 1st February; Late Application Date: 1st May; Change of Mind: 1st July.

Some courses offer a Special Entrance Language Examination, allowing Leaving Certificate students a second opportunity to meet the H3 language entry requirement in either French, Irish, German, Spanish, or Japanese.
